name: LM5164
description: 100 V, 1 A synchronous COT buck with power-good and 10.5 µA quiescent current, for 48 V and 60 V+ robot or e-bike packs.
notes: RON resistor sets the switching frequency (up to 1 MHz; 300 kHz in the datasheet design).
Diode emulation at light load; the EP has no electrical connection, tie it to GND.
COT control needs some output ripple at FB; use the datasheet ripple-injection network with ceramic caps.

en.note: EN/UVLO abs max 100 V = VIN abs max; the typical application (Fig 7-1) ties EN/UVLO straight to VIN, and sec. 6.3.9 allows a logic drive or a direct VIN connection. Below 1.1 V: shutdown (3 µA); 1.1-1.5 V: standby (VCC on, no switching); above 1.5 V typ (1.45-1.55) rising / 1.4 V falling: run. Optional UVLO divider RUV1 (VIN-EN) / RUV2 (EN-GND): VIN(on) = 1.5 V*(1 + RUV1/RUV2), VIN(off) = 1.4 V*(1 + RUV1/RUV2); RUV1 ~1 MΩ recommended.

pg.note: PGOOD is open drain; pull up through 10-100 kΩ to a DC rail of no more than 14 V (use a divider from a higher rail). Releases when FB > 95 % of VREF (VPG-UTH 1.14 V), pulls low (25-30 Ω) when FB < 90 % (VPG-LTH 1.08 V); 5 µs rising-edge deglitch. The typical application leaves PGOOD unconnected.

extras.note: Sets the COT on-time / CCM frequency. Eq. 12/15: RRON[kΩ] = VOUT[V]*2500 / FSW[kHz]; equivalently FSW[kHz] = VOUT*2500/RRON (Eq. 1). On-time Eq. 11: tON[us] = RRON[kΩ] / (VIN[V]*2.5). Keep tON >= 50 ns at max VIN and FSW <= 1 MHz. Examples at 300 kHz: 3.3 V -> 27.5 k, 5 V -> 41.7 k, 12 V -> 100 k (typ. app). RON is noise sensitive: place RRON close, parasitic RON-GND capacitance <= 20 pF.

rippleInjection.note: Type 3 (datasheet sec. 7.2.2.6): RA from SW and CA to VOUT build a triangle; CB couples it into FB. CA ≥ 10 / (fsw·(RFB1‖RFB2)); RA·CA ≤ tON·(VIN − VOUT) / 20 mV; CB ≥ tsettle / (3·RFB1). C0G for CB.

notes: Constant on-time (COT), no loop compensation; nearly constant CCM frequency set by RRON (300 kHz in the typical app, up to 1 MHz). Diode emulation and pulse skipping at light load, ultra-low IQ sleep (10.5 µA) after 15 µs idle. Fixed 3 ms soft start. No VCC pin (internal bias, no external cap); internal boot diode.

Min controllable on-time 50 ns (rec. op. tON 50-10000 ns); min off-time 50 ns typ, forced to 250 ns when tON < 300 ns. Min duty DMIN = tON(min)*FSW (Eq. 16); VIN(max) before frequency foldback = VOUT/(tON(min)*FSW) (Eq. 17). Not in the EC table as a min/typ/max spec.

Current limit: high-side peak 1.5 A typ (1.25-1.75), low-side backup peak 1.5 A, foldback valley 1.2 A typ (0.95-1.4). Inductor saturation current must be well above the current limit. Rec. op. load 1 A nominal, 1.25 A max.
CBST must be 2.2 nF, 50 V X7R (abs max range 1.5-2.5 nF). A larger cap stresses and can damage the internal VCC regulator; a smaller one will not drive the HS FET.
Inductor (Eq. 20): LO = VOUT/(FSW*dIL) * (1 - VOUT/VIN(nom)) with dIL = 30-50 % of rated load at nominal VIN. Typical app: 68 µH (447 mA p-p at 48 V in, 45 %).
Output cap (Eq. 21): COUT = dIL / (8*FSW*VOUT(ripple)), with ripple <= 0.5 % of VOUT; ceramic X7R. Typical app 2x22 µF 25 V X7R (BOM Table 7-1; Fig 7-1 shows 47 µF).

Feedback: VREF 1.2 V (1.181-1.218). RFB2 = 1.2 V/(VOUT - 1.2 V) * RFB1 (Eq. 10); select RFB1 in 100 kΩ-1 MΩ (not above 1 MΩ). Typical app RFB1 453 k / RFB2 49.9 k for 12 V (BOM part number suggests 448 k, value column says 453 k).

Other ripple schemes (Table 6-1): Type 1 = resistor RESR in series with COUT, RESR >= VOUT*20 mV/(VFB*dIL(nom)) and RESR >= VOUT/(2*VIN*FSW*COUT) (Eq. 2-3). Type 2 = RESR plus CFF across RFB1: RESR >= 20 mV/dIL(nom), RESR >= VOUT/(2*VIN*FSW*COUT), CFF >= 1/(2*pi*FSW*(RFB1 || RFB2)) (Eq. 4-6). Type 3 (used) gives the lowest output ripple.

Input: high-frequency ceramic >= 2.2 µF X7R/X7S rated ~2x max VIN, close to VIN/GND (typical app BOM µses 2x 2.2 µF 100 V). IIN ripple / CIN Eq. 22-23. Add bulk if the source is more than ~5 cm away; a 10 µF electrolytic with ~0.5 Ω ESR damps most inputs.
Layout: minimise the CIN-VIN-GND loop; keep SW copper small; FB divider and ripple network close to FB; RRON close to RON.
Catalog check: VIN 6-100 V, 1 A, 300 kHz (typical app) and VOUT min 1.2 V (= VREF) agree. The datasheet does not state a maximum VOUT; the 90 V in the catalog comes from the TI product page.
